ayahs.5: each soul will know what it sent ahead and left behind.
ayahs.6: O humanity—what has made you bold against your Rabb, the Most Generous,
ayahs.7: Who created you, fashioned you, and balanced your form,
ayahs.8: moulding you in whatever shape He willed?
ayahs.10: while vigilant, honourable angels record everything.
ayahs.11: Noble scribes are appointed over you,
ayahs.13: The truly virtuous will be in bliss,
ayahs.14: and the wicked in a blazing Fire,
ayahs.17: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
ayahs.18: Again—what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
ayahs.19: It is the Day no soul can benefit another at all. All authority that Day belongs to Allah alone.
